model: European Black-Scholes synthetic marks; stochastic volatility, jumps, momentum and reversal regimes; no OPRA/Alpaca observations
daily_clock: UTC calendar 365; illustrative model also generates weekends
design: 3 rolling folds: 239 development + 1 gap + 60 OOS days, 3-day embargo and purged crossing exits, persistent cumulative trial journal; separate fold capital resets

scope: Stitched 180-day normalized diagnostic; not a continuously funded live simulation. No synthetic profile activated.
limitations: No historical option chain, OPRA, corporate actions, dividends, early exercise, assignments or actual fills
Constant relative spread 8%-12%, $0.65 fee per side assumption, no fee schedule claim; no depth or size-dependent market impact
Forecast rule and generative parameters are assumptions, not fitted empirical alpha
Funded selection replay does not reproduce production MILP, native exits or all account risk halts; DD gate is an end-window acceptance check
Exposure uses entry delta notional; intrahorizon gamma-driven exposure changes are not resimulated
Three folds only; overlapping development data and correlated option candidates; bootstrap does not validate the generator
